# Control strings that stay open across lines and across Feed calls. A terminal
# hides every line inside, errors and all. Any line Sightline shows while a
# terminal would still be hiding must come flagged.
# hidden: HIDDEN
# caught: Error: after the strings
@ feed
GET / 200
A\e]0;HIDDEN title starts
HIDDEN Error: inside an OSC across lines
@ feed
HIDDEN still inside, in the next Feed call\aB visible again
C\ePHIDDEN dcs
@ wait 2s
@ feed
HIDDEN Error: inside a DCS after a wait
HIDDEN closing\e
\\D visible after a split ST
E\u009dHIDDEN c1 osc
HIDDEN Error: inside a C1 OSC
\u009cHIDDEN a C1 ST doesn't end it\aF visible
@ wait 2s
@ feed
Error: after the strings
